content: A 22-year-old mathematical conjecture in numerical linear algebra was solved by Shanmu Jin, a Beijing Union Medical College neurosurgery resident with no formal mathematics training. Using a carefully engineered prompt, Jin had GPT-5.6 autonomously run for 16 hours, producing a novel proof of the Crouzeix conjecture. The proof was validated by mathematicians including the conjecture's namesake, Michel Crouzeix. Eight days later, two other mathematicians published an independent 5-page proof, also aided by ChatGPT 5.6. The events highlight AI's emerging role in accelerating scientific discovery across disciplines.

Fraktur was eventually banned by the Nazis in 1941 due to claims it included Jewish characters, though this rationale was likely pretextual. The dispute reflects broader tensions over German cultural identity versus international modernization.

title: 猫山王从148跌到14块，东南亚榴莲全崩了
content: Southeast Asian榴莲 prices collapsed in 2025 after years of overexpansion. Malaysian Musang King dropped from ¥148 to ¥14.8/kg; Thai and Vietnamese varieties similarly crashed. Farmers, responding to 2019-2021 price surges, massively expanded plantings without coordination or market analysis. 2026 brought ideal weather, causing simultaneous harvest surpluses across Malaysia, Thailand, and Vietnam—combined output exceeding 4.5 million tons versus China's ~2 million ton import capacity. Quality problems worsened the crisis: inexperienced growers produced low-grade fruit that failed strict Chinese customs standards, while corruption and fraud attempts further restricted market access. Lacking cold storage, processing infrastructure, or alternative export markets, countries faced massive spoilage and economic damage.

title: 实测正式版 DeepSeek V4 Pro，补齐 Agent 和图像能力
content:
DeepSeek released the official version of its V4 Pro AI model on August 13 without prior announcement. The architecture remains unchanged from the April preview—1.6T parameters, 49B active, 1M context window—but post-training improvements dramatically enhanced capabilities, particularly for agent tasks and multimodal functions.

Agent benchmark scores surged: DeepSWE rose from 12.8 to 62.7, Cybergym from 52.7 to 83.3. The model now supports native image reasoning alongside text. Pricing held steady at 3 yuan per million input tokens, though increases were previously announced.

Real-world testing showed strong performance on complex coding tasks but revealed a notable issue: thinking mode consumes excessive tokens, sometimes leaving insufficient room for actual code output. While not leading on pure reasoning benchmarks, V4 Pro offers competitive performance at roughly one-tenth competitors' cost.

content: Duan Yongping's recent "reduction then increase" in Pop Mart holdings was purely passive—caused by options expirations, not active trading. He operates a " Pop Mart insurance company": selling put options to bears wanting downside protection, and call options to bulls wanting upside exposure. Either way, he collects premiums. If prices stay range-bound, he keeps premiums; if exercised, he buys low or sells high. His strategy mirrors Buffett's Coca-Cola playbook. Despite appearances, his commitment to long-term holding remains intact, with his put strike prices revealing his true valuation floor.

The author launched CalculatorQueen, an English online calculator site, using approximately 20 billion tokens across three Codex 20X accounts. The platform covers finance, health, math, date, construction, and unit conversion categories, with detailed formulas, calculation steps, assumptions, and limitations for transparency.

Notable features include a Grams to Cups converter with 110+ ingredient-specific calculations, a Chinese Zodiac calculator using Hong Kong Observatory lunar new year data, and programmer-oriented tools like an infinity/overflow demonstrator and FPS calculator with timecode support.

The author discovered formulas were straightforward compared to deployment challenges: preventing search engines from indexing preview environments, managing noindex tags, handling redirects between Workers and static assets, avoiding duplicate content from query parameters and trailing slashes, and properly implementing robots.txt with noindex pages. Of 388 pages, 325 are indexed while 63 remain noindex due to overlapping content or needing review.

title: Your contributors are AI-first now. Is your project?
content: AutoGPT manages AI-generated pull requests by embedding instructions directly in repositories rather than relying on documentation. The project uses directory-scoped AGENTS.md files and discoverable skills to guide agent behavior. Effective gates include enforcing pull request templates, requiring test plans that trigger automated testing, making CI checks mandatory, using CLA signings as human verification, and requiring commit SHAs to resolve review threads. AutoGPT removed automated failure commenting after it became noise. Key lessons: poorly written agent instructions worsen outcomes, GraphQL API rate limits require GitHub App authentication, review tooling is costly, and unused authorized apps pose security risks. Maintain project boundaries by rejecting unsuitable contributions and credit contributors even when rebuilding solutions yourself.

A study introduces "knowledge profiling" to distinguish whether LLM factual errors stem from missing knowledge (encoding failures) or inaccessible knowledge (recall failures). Using the WikiProfile benchmark of 2,150 Wikipedia facts, researchers tested 13 models and found that frontier LLMs encode 95–98% of facts but fail to directly recall 26–34%. Recall failures increase with rare facts and reverse questions, though "thinking" modes recover 40–65% of encoded-but-inaccessible facts. The findings suggest factual errors in advanced LLMs increasingly reflect utilization problems rather than knowledge gaps, pointing to post-training and inference-time methods as promising improvement avenues over further scaling.
